payload.title: integrate-smoke fails in a fresh unit worktree
payload.body: test/deploy/integrate-smoke.test.ts (forge) failed in worktree cratylus.unit-install-placement at the guard existsSync(binDir/cratylus) after pnpm install, typecheck build; it passes in the main checkout. Unproven cause: likely the cratylus hub dist unbuilt in a fresh worktree. Unit install-placement did not touch that path.
